initial_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.
submitted_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.

However, the supplied regulatory result found no verified gross-area threshold, and the 4 sqm per child regional standard applies to specified net-use areas, not the property’s total gross area. Turin planning compatibility, change-of-use and building permissions, health and safety requirements, accessibility, and the authorization regime applicable on the application date all require confirmation. The score of 83 reflects the property’s strong location, building, energy, and proximity indicators, alongside unresolved regulatory feasibility.
pros: At 340.85 sqm, the unit is larger than the requested 115 sqm gross area screening threshold; the supplied data do not establish its usable layout or regulatory sufficiency.
Energy class C meets the requested D-or-better target; the energy subscore total is 10.
Green proximity is high (91.96 percentile), with strong access to education (99.88) and other services.
cons: The regulatory agent found no verified gross-area threshold, and the applicable authorization regime and transition to the 2025 framework need confirmation.
Turin PRG compatibility, change-of-use and building permits, and sector authorization are unverified.
Net usable areas, accessibility, hygiene, fire safety where required, and structural suitability for the proposed use have not been established.
